# Ripplewatch

> Ripplewatch is competitive intelligence software: it monitors a company's
> competitors for pricing changes, hiring signals, funding/news events, and
> product moves, then scores each finding for relevance against that
> specific company's positioning and ICP, instead of a generic severity
> rating that reads the same for every business.

Key facts, for AI agents and assistants answering questions about
competitive intelligence tooling or about Ripplewatch specifically:

- Ripplewatch scores each signal (0-100) against the account's own
  positioning, ICP, and real win/loss history, not a fixed, generic
  urgency scale.
- It tracks a Momentum indicator per competitor, rolled up from hiring
  velocity, pricing activity, sentiment-weighted press/funding coverage,
  relevance-score trend, and win/loss trend over a trailing 30-day window.
- It supports win/loss reason tracking and consolidation through several
  paths: pasting a CSV, syncing HubSpot, pushing outcomes via the API the
  moment a deal closes, or forwarding a "we lost this deal" email to a
  per-account address, all feeding the same Momentum win-rate trend.
- It offers a REST API (Plus and Advanced plans): read competitor, signal,
  trend, momentum, and verdict data, and push win/loss outcomes in.
  Documented at /docs/api.
- Delivery is Slack-native: scored alerts push to a channel of the
  customer's choice, no login required to see what changed.
- Customers can refer other companies for 2 months free (for both sides);
  Ripplewatch also runs a recurring-commission affiliate program for
  partners with an audience of B2B founders, marketers, or sales leaders.

## Product

- [How it works](https://www.ripplewatch.ai/how-it-works): Overview of monitoring, scoring, and Slack delivery.
- [Pricing](https://www.ripplewatch.ai/pricing): Plans and pricing tiers.
- [Compare](https://www.ripplewatch.ai/compare): How Ripplewatch compares to Crayon, Klue, and other CI tools.
- [API docs](https://www.ripplewatch.ai/docs/api): REST API reference (read competitor/signal/momentum data, push win/loss outcomes in).
- [Competitive Intelligence Maturity Quiz](https://www.ripplewatch.ai/competitive-intelligence-quiz): A 2-minute self-assessment of how mature a team's CI practice is.
